text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, while having lunch outside
with Haru Urara...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It looks delicious,
the "Special ☆ Delicious Burger"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: S-So souuuur...! There's... pickles... in heeere...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having unknowingly eaten the vegetables she hated,
Haru Urara ended up
losing all her energy...
